theme_and_archetype.description: A cursed, nostalgic Windows 95 desktop environment mixed with weird vaporwave, glitchy, and early internet aesthetics. Think GeoCities meets Habbo Hotel.

typography.notes: VT323 renders quite small, so use text-lg or text-xl for normal reading. Never use anti-aliasing (use antialiased false or pixelated rendering if possible).

spacing_and_layout.desktop: fixed inset-0 w-screen h-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#008080]
spacing_and_layout.window: absolute flex flex-col min-w-[300px] bg-[#c0c0c0] p-[2px]
spacing_and_layout.window_header: flex justify-between items-center bg-[#000080] px-1 py-0.5 select-none
spacing_and_layout.taskbar: absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-[35px] bg-[#c0c0c0] flex items-center px-1 z-50
spacing_and_layout.desktop_icons: absolute top-0 left-0 flex flex-col flex-wrap gap-6 p-4 h-[calc(100vh-40px)]

components.window_border: border-t-2 border-l-2 border-white border-r-2 border-b-2 border-black shadow-[inset_-1px_-1px_#808080,inset_1px_1px_#dfdfdf]
components.recessed_border: border-t-2 border-l-2 border-[#808080] border-r-2 border-b-2 border-white shadow-[inset_1px_1px_#000000]
components.button: bg-[#c0c0c0] px-4 py-1 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-white border-r-2 border-b-2 border-black shadow-[inset_-1px_-1px_#808080,inset_1px_1px_#dfdfdf] active:border-t-black active:border-l-black active:border-r-white active:border-b-white active:shadow-[inset_1px_1px_#000000] focus:outline-dotted focus:outline-1 focus:outline-black focus:outline-offset-[-4px]
components.desktop_icon_container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 w-20 cursor-pointer text-white text-center drop-shadow-[1px_1px_0_#000]
components.scanlines: pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[9999] opacity-10 bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,0,0.06),rgba(0,255,0,0.02),rgba(0,0,255,0.06))] bg-[length:100%_4px,3px_100%]

textures.description: Weird Vaporwave Win95 Desktop Wallpaper (Optional override for solid teal)

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: No smooth transitions! Use instant state changes to simulate old software. Buttons depress instantly.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Add a faint flickering CSS animation to text inputs. Use a blink animation for the custom text cursor.
motion_and_interactions.dragging: Windows must be draggable via the navy title bar. When dragged, the z-index should increase to bring it to front.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Shadcn UI or rounded corners for Windows. Every window must be perfectly square and use the chunky 90s bevels defined in components.window_border.
Implement the desktop container with relative or fixed positioning, and use absolute positioning for all windows (chat, jukebox, upload, worlds) so they can overlap and be dragged.
The Isometric Worlds should be implemented as a recessed panel containing the world background image, with user avatars rendered as absolute elements inside it.
Add 'data-testid' to everything. e.g. data-testid='start-button', data-testid='chat-window', data-testid='upload-dialog'.
For the Start button: Use the Win95 standard style, containing a Windows logo icon and 'Start' text.

To achieve the 'g00dweird' vibe, inject random marquee tags in the chat, use a custom crosshair or pixel pointer cursor via CSS (cursor: crosshair), and overlay the scanlines div on top of everything with pointer-events: none.
